articles.title: Marcus Corporation Announces Kim M. Lueck to Retire

articles.summary: The highly anticipated installment in the beloved franchise also resulted in the all-time highest combined concession, merchandise, and food and beverage revenue for a June opening weekend Marcus Theatres® , the nation’s fourth largest theatre circuit and a division of Marcus Corporation (NYSE: MCS), today announced that the opening weekend of Toy Story 5 and strong carryover performances from several films delivered record total revenue and record combined concession, merchandise, and food and beverage revenue for a June opening weekend. Fans of all ages turned out for Toy Story 5 , from young children meeting Jessie, Woody and Buzz Lightyear for the first time to longtime moviegoers who have followed the franchise for decades.
